children.name: Talinum caffrum  Eckl. & Zeyh.
children.description: Perennial herb or subshrub, in wooded savannah and coastal sands.

children.name: Talinum crispatulum Dinter
children.description: The native range of this species is Eritrea to N. Cape Prov.. It is a tuberous subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Talinum domingense Urb. & Ekman
children.description: The native range of this species is Hispaniola. It is a succulent perennial and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Talinum galapagosum  Hershk.
children.description: The native range of this species is Galápagos (I. San Crostóbal: Soppho Cave). It is a succulent subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Talinum porphyreum M.Mend. & J.R.I.Wood
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia to Paraguay. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Talinum rostratum Ruiz & Pav. ex Lopez
Talinum sonorae D.J.Ferguson
children.description: The native range of this species is Arizona to New Mexico and Mexico (Baja California Sur). It grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Talinum tenuissimum Dinter
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Kenya to E. Tanzania, S. Africa. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Talinum fruticosum
children.description: Talinum fruticosum is a herbaceous perennial plant that is native to Mexico, the Caribbean, West Africa, Central America, and much of South America.

children.name: Talinum paniculatum
children.description: Talinum paniculatum is a succulent subshrub in the family Talinaceae that is native to much of North and South America, and the Caribbean countries.

children.name: Talinum lineare
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Talinum portulacifolium
children.description: ECOLOGY. — Annual species, present in many stations. ÉCOLOGIE. — Espèce lignifiée, occupant des terrains arides et incultes.

children.name: Talinum polygaloides
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. U.S.A. to N. Mexico (to Jalisco), Peru to W. Argentina. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Talinum arnotii
children.description: The native range of this species is Kenya to S. Africa. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Talinum nocturnum
children.description: The native range of this species is Bolivia to Paraguay. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Amphipetalum paraguayense
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Bolivia to Paraguay. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Anacampseros telephiastrum
children.description: Anacampseros telephiastrum is a species of succulent plant native to the southern Karoo region of the Western Cape and Eastern Cape Provinces of South Africa, from Robertson in the west, to Somerset East in the east.
